body_lead: VISAKHAPATNAM: The State government, in partnership with Cyient Foundation, has set up Artificial Intelligence (AI), STEM, and Robotics laboratories in 50 government schools across Visakhapatnam district. Minister for IT, Education and Human Resources Development Nara Lokesh inaugurated the lab at Chandrampalem Government School and formally launched the remaining labs across the district.
